content: Official AWS ECS/Fargate, Azure Container Apps, and Google Cloud Run docs support Python containers and distinct web/background workload patterns; Cloud Run containers have disposable local filesystems and supports separate services/jobs/worker pools. Viable mappings are ECS Fargate + RDS + SQS + S3, Container Apps + Azure PostgreSQL + Service Bus + Blob, or Cloud Run + Cloud SQL + Cloud Tasks + Cloud Storage. Select only after region, outbound scraper IP needs, AI procurement, cost and operator capability are known.
